purpose: Index submission evidence while separating authentic development provenance, synthetic application-runtime telemetry, and retrospective narrative.

sourceSnapshot.role: Antigravity system-generated transcript snapshot retained outside the repository
sourceSnapshot.exclusionReason: The untouched system transcript can contain workstation paths, uploaded-media locations, personal information, signed URLs, or credentials. Its digest and metadata are retained so the reviewed derivative can be tied to the source snapshot without publishing the raw file.

redactions: project root and other absolute local paths
well-known API-key, bearer-token, JWT, and private-key patterns
secret assignment values and database connection strings

supportingPrivateProvenance.note: Individual Antigravity task logs remain outside the repository. The manifest digest is SHA-256 of sorted lines in the form filename:byte-length:file-sha256.

otherTraceLikeArtifacts.note: Illustrates an application-runtime seven-agent chain for a synthetic case. It must not be presented as development provenance or a real patient record.
Useful navigation aid, but it is a narrative summary rather than timestamped source evidence.

knownGaps: The first retained event is followed by a system checkpoint stating that earlier conversation context was truncated; unavailable earlier raw content was not reconstructed.
The repository did not contain historical Git commits when this manifest was prepared, so file-change provenance before repository initialization cannot be independently reconstructed from Git.
The raw Antigravity transcript is intentionally not included; judges receive the redacted derivative and source digests.
Runtime fixture telemetry is synthetic and does not establish medical-device performance, clinical efficacy, or real-world patient outcomes.
